Score trend · v3 scoring basis (full tree, Drive API)

Three v3-basis runs, 61 → 60 → 62 — two points recovered this month by clearing the credential exposure. The gap to the 85 "runs unattended and trusted" ceiling is the standing work below.

1 · What this run did

Measured

  • Full-tree census through the Drive API, cloud-only — the laptop was never in the loop. Batched breadth-first over the whole workspace; archive excluded from the score.
  • Kernel-vs-memory drift check: CLEAR. The rules on disk and in the cross-surface memory floor agree in substance; the check ran against the live files, not the lagging project-doc snapshot.
  • Credential scan across the tree — the first-class security pass.
  • Four-pillar score recomputed from this run's census; every figure traces to an API pull.

Published (create-only, nothing moved or deleted)

  • Private master record written to Drive with the full, unsanitised detail — paths, findings, the reversible archive list.
  • Dated history + scheduler snapshot appended as new files (the audit trail is never overwritten).
  • This scoreboard mirrored verbatim to the public handoff file for the separate publisher routine to push.
  • No autonomous delete, move, or rename — every cleanup is proposed as a list for a human to action by hand.

6 · Action plan · owner: operator

  1. Confirm the six tokens are revoked at GitHub.VERIFY The plaintext credential files are gone from Drive (verified this run, 6 to 0). What a cloud run cannot see is whether each token was revoked at the provider — deleting the file does not revoke the token. Confirm at GitHub; keep the durable fix (repo authorisation or a secret store, not a plaintext file).
  2. Restart the parked synthesis work.THIS MONTH It is the single lever on the ~4.9% knowledge-base synthesis floor — the system hoards raw intake and rarely distils it.
  3. Turn off the upstream "convert uploads to Google Docs" setting, then re-export the 13 stubs.THIS MONTH Each stub is a real document reduced to an unreadable pointer — silent data loss. Detection alone is a treadmill; the setting is the source.
  4. Re-sync the project-doc kernel copies and clear the by-hand hygiene list.WHEN CONVENIENT The mounted-session kernel copies lag; a duplicate output folder, loose backups and the two empty governance folders remain. All reversible, all in the private record; the audit will not touch files unattended.
  5. Update the claude.ai health artifact.SETUP Scheduled cloud runs have no artifact tool, so the db-write is owed to the next interactive session; the public site is fed by this handoff instead.

The one human decision that is the bottleneck

Confirm the six GitHub tokens were revoked at the provider. The plaintext files are gone from Drive and the routines now authenticate through repo authorisation rather than synced tokens — but a file deletion is not a revocation, and only you can see the GitHub token list. Once confirmed, the standing #1 red is closed for the first time. Everything else on this board is hygiene the system proposes but cannot execute; the knowledge-base synthesis floor is the next durable drag. The machine censused, scored, confirmed the remediation, published cloud-only, and pushed the scoreboard — nothing destroyed.

Sanitised scoreboard. It carries only the score, per-pillar RAG and deltas, trend, plain counts, guardrail PASS/FAIL, and the credential-scan count + PASS/FAIL. It never carries a secret value or path, a file or folder listing, a person's name, an inbox detail, a private financial figure, or an automation trigger URL — those stay in the private .md record on Drive.
